description.narrative: Assumptions: There is sufficient interest and pooled funding available to continue growth of SR Risk Pool. Contingency Plans are accurate and informed by real vulnerability/targeting data.The likelihood of more triggers occuring that can be funded is low but will vary across risk pools included in the 25/28 period. That agencies' reports and technical evaluations agree on timing of the "peak" or the "timeliness" in comparison to response alerts. Definition is agreed by stakeholders.Awarded agencies have interest and capacity to provide access to affected populations. Access is possible, physically.

Start Ready is a disaster risk financing mechanism that enables anticipatory action and rapid response to predictable hazards through pre-positioned funding and locally-led humanitarian systems.Impact: A locally-led humanitarian system that anticipates and responds proactively to predictable and recurring hazards, expanding the reach of pre-positioned funding across diverse regions and risks to protect lives, enhance recovery, and uphold the dignity and resilience of communities at risk.

humanitarian-scope.narrative: Nepal Multi-Hazard Response: Floods, Landslides, Heatwave, Coldwave, and Health Emergencies

policy-marker.narrative: Disaster risk reduction is a principal objective - anticipatory action and preparedness
Gender equality is a significant objective - all data disaggregated by sex

title.narrative: Pre-positioned funding via DRF and SR enables rapid disbursement of funds, facilitating efficient action before the risk season to enable timely and effective implementation of anticipatory action and early action.
% of project that started implementation before the peak of the crisis

description.narrative: Source: Collected via project Report Form, within 30 days of a project intervention being completed. Frequency of report depends on the frequency of activations. Calculated by comparing the date on which the first activity was implemented to the date of the peak of the crisis, as defined by members. Baseline calculated with figures from risk Pool 1, 2 and 3 until december 2024.

title.narrative: Efficiency stretch achieved across the risk pool

description.narrative: Source: This indicator demonstrates the Unique Selling Point of Start Ready, which is the positive impact of pooling funds and the stretch enabled to protect more people per £ committed when compared to non-pooled funds. The stretch is not guaranteed, as it is informed by decision making at the time of pool establishment.

title.narrative: # of people reached by Start Ready activations (per risk in event of activation of trigger)

description.narrative: Source: Collected via project Report Form, within 30 days of a project intervention being completed. Frequency of report depends on the frequency of activations. Calculated by the sum of direct reach of each project (excluding mass communication activities and indirect reach). Baseline calculated with reach figures from risk Pool 1, 2 and 3 until december 2024.

title.narrative: DRF systems are co-created through an evidence-based process with active collaboration from diverse local and national stakeholders to strengthen and refine DRF systems.
% of implementation plans where the lead agency is a local actor

description.narrative: Source: contingency plans where LNNGO were the lead or convening agency.

title.narrative: # of learning resources per risk pool designed to enhance learning developed (incl. research and evaluations and learning papers)

description.narrative: Source: Includes any outputs created to support and improve learning, such as research papers, evaluation reports and learning papers produced at the global level. These resources are intended to provide valuable insights that enhance the knowledge and understanding of AA and Start Ready mechanims of different stakeholders. The number of evaluations will depend on the number of activations - we estimate around 3-5 evaluations per year. This is cumulative.

title.narrative: Increased coverage and accessibility of national DRF systems through the annual Start Ready Risk Pool, enabling anticipatory action and rapid response to predictable hazards, ultimately protecting more people from disaster impacts.
# of national DRF systems included in the annual Risk Pool to enable anticipatory action and rapid response ahead of predictable hazards

description.narrative: Source: National level to disaster risk financing systems (i.e humanitarian systems that are based on pre-planning: predicting crises, pre-planning activities and pre-positioning financing that can be released when a crisis is forecast), that are attached to Start Ready global Risk Pool.

title.narrative: # of people protected by annual Start Ready risk pool

description.narrative: Protection for Start Ready involves providing coverage to a community and ensuring that Start Network members are prepared to act with specific services to lessen the impact of risks. These services should be based on community needs and be proven to have a positive effect. This protection is organized through coverage under a Start Ready Risk Pool for a 12-month period. It guarantees protectionregardless of whether a crisis happens and contingency plans are activated; protection figures are not informed by funding disbursement and activity implementation. This figure is not-cumulative.
